svg.title: The oracle screen, rebuilt from measurements
svg.desc: The oracle's window, drawn from a capture of the live app (1040 by 760 points): every box, colour and corner is measured, and the bots' avatars are plain grey stand-ins. It plays one real turn, timed from a recording: a question is typed and sent, the bubble slides up, a working line reads Checking system storage under a moving shimmer, the bot's short reply lands above it, the line changes to Typing, the answer arrives and the line leaves. The bot's computer sleeps on the right. The words, the typing and the loop reset are ours. With reduced motion it shows the finished turn, still. Generated by scripts/generate-hero.mjs.
